messages:
rachel: Pushed a tiny UI experiment: a compact toolbar above the schema editor with presets (eg: 'HTTP API', 'Email parse', 'Chat turn'). Want quick UX + a11y eyes before I ship.

omar: Nice! Are presets applied in-place or open a confirm modal?

rachel: Applied in-place with an undo toast. The idea is fast iteration without modal friction.

priya: Inline apply is fast but we need an accessible announce. Add aria-live polite announcing 'Preset applied: Email parse' so screen reader users know the schema changed.

elliot: Hit targets look small on touch. The preset pills are 32px; bump to 44px min touch area and keep visual compactness with padding.

priya: Also keyboard: left/right should move between pills and Enter/Space applies. Add roving tabindex (only focused pill tabindex=0).

omar: Copy nit: current tooltip says 'Apply preset'  maybe 'Apply preset to schema' or include the preset name: 'Apply: Email parse'. Clearer in tooltips.

rachel: Will update tooltip copy and add SR-friendly aria-label on the button like 'Apply preset Email parse'.

ui-bot: accessibility-check: contrast on pill hover fails AA at current token-neutral-200 on neutral-50. Recommend token-primary-600 for hover bg.

priya: Motion: when preset swaps schema, there's a short diff animation. Respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep animation <=120ms. Also provide a 'Show changes' disclosure for users who want to inspect diffs before accepting.

elliot: Small UX idea: include a tiny provenance badge on the pill if preset was community-sourced vs internal. Low-contrast badge 'community' / 'core'. Make it aria-hidden decorative.

omar: About undo: the toast currently disappears after 3s which is too short for keyboard users to find. Make it 6s and include 'Undo' button focusable. Also ensure Escape clears the toast without losing keyboard focus context.

rachel: Thanks — changes I'll make: bump touch area, roving tabindex, aria-live message, tooltip copy, hover token swap, prefers-reduced-motion support, and extend undo toast. I'll add the provenance badge as decorative.

priya: I'll run VO + NVDA checks tomorrow and post results. If any edge cases pop up, we can toggle the apply behavior to confirm modal behind a feature flag.

ui-bot: deploy: playground-schema-presets-toolbar-1769999999 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:

rachel: Great, merging after the accessibility run. Ping if you want a demo. :sparkles:
